subject: Short pilot: patchwork discount framework & extension request
messages:
From: Ava Morris <ava@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Short pilot — need a 3-week runway + pricing ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the support during our initial week of the pilot. We hit a couple of technical blockers on our side (data ingest mapping + redaction rules) and won’t be able to exercise the full evaluation plan in the remaining days.

Would Redwood be open to a short runway extension? Specifically we’re asking for an additional 3 weeks on the same environment with the following ask:
- Either a 3-week add-on at a discounted rate OR a 2-week add-on + a $5k conversion credit if we decide to move to Dedicated within 90 days.
- We’d like token-level breakdown or an hour-pool option — our infra team prefers a timebox they can run without surprise throttling.

Attached is the current SOW and a short note from our security team outlining the blockers. We’re on a tight procurement timeline (end of month), so any quick options would help.

Attachments: [pilot-sow.docx (22KB)]

Best,
Ava Morris
Head of Data Platforms
Greenfield Health
ava@greenfieldhealth.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Morris <ava@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Short pilot — need a 3-week runway + pricing ask

Hi Ava — appreciate the heads up and the SOW. Short answer: yes, we can structure an extension. Two quick approaches that might fit your procurement path — I’ll list them so you can pick which your team prefers, and I’ll loop in finance to confirm final numbers.

Option A — Timebox + modest discount
- Add 3 weeks to the existing pilot environment.
- 12% off the incremental weeks (applies to token/hour pool portion only).
- Same SLA/throughput window.

Option B — Hybrid top-up + conversion credit
- Add 2 weeks now + a $5k conversion credit if you commit to a Dedicated reservation within 90 days.
- 18% off the incremental 2-week fee (higher discount since there’s a conversion credit attached).

Notes:
- We can also offer an hour-pool alias (x compute-hours) instead of token billing for the extension if your infra prefers it — that’s an operational mapping we can include in the addendum.
- If you need a stronger discount for procurement sign-off, I can send an internal approval request to budget owners (looping Prio/m and Laura).

Next steps: please confirm which option you prefer and whether you want tokens or hour-pool. I’ll prepare a short addendum and a redline-ready quote.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Ava Morris <ava@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-17T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Short pilot — need a 3-week runway + pricing ask

Looping in on the extension — I reviewed the SOW and asked pricing team for a clean quote (attached). A few operational points before we send an offer to the customer:

- Procurement sensitivity: They flagged multi-line items and prefer a single addendum showing either (a) a 3-week flat line item with a discount, or (b) a 2-week line + conversion credit line so it’s explicit for their finance team.
- Discount guardrails: Our playbook supports up to 15% for short runway extensions without VP approval if tied to a conversion path. Anything above that needs a approvals ticket.
- Success milestone: I recommend we include a single success milestone (pass ingest + redaction test) that, if hit, converts the $5k credit to an additional 1-week free. That keeps incentives aligned and reduces the finance write-off risk.

I’ve attached a draft quote (quote_GFHPilot_v2.xlsx) and a quick redline of a 3-week addendum. If Karthik wants to offer the 3-week at 12% now and reserve the right to bump to 15% pending VP sign-off, I can expedite paperwork.

Attachments: [quote_GFHPilot_v2.xlsx (12KB)]

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Hi Ava — thanks for the patience while we coordinated internally. Per the options we discussed, here’s the formal offer we can execute quickly:

Final offer (authorized):
- 3-week addendum to the existing pilot environment.
- 12% discount on the incremental 3-week fee (token/hour pool as you prefer).
- Success milestone: if the ingest + redaction test passes within the extension window, we will apply a $5k credit that can be used toward a Dedicated reservation or redeemed as service credit.
- Addendum will include an operational hour-pool mapping appendix if you prefer hours over tokens.

We’re attaching the updated offer (patch_offer_v3.pdf). If that looks good, please sign the DocuSign envelope below and we’ll provision the extension within 24 hours of receipt.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/envelope12345
Attachments: [patch_offer_v3.pdf (9KB)]

If you want the 2-week + $5k conversion-credit route instead, we can send an alternate quote with an 18% discount on the 2-week fee — let me know today and I’ll swap the doc.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
